candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Machine Learning Working Student position. Detecting defects with vision models on real production lines is a direct step up from my computer vision projects, and I would like to learn it with a team that ships models to production.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. My computer vision work is in Python, PyTorch and OpenCV, and I keep my code in Git with tests and CI.

achievements.impact: I fine-tuned a pretrained EfficientNet-B0 on retinal OCT scans, reaching 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set, with denoising and augmentation in preprocessing
for my B.S. thesis team I tested EasyOCR configurations for scoreboard extraction and tuned the event detection model
my RAG project DocuMind has 37 offline unit tests, GitHub Actions CI and Docker

letter.problems_section: I would help prototype vision models, evaluate them carefully and support getting them running on real lines. I have not yet trained diffusion models, used SAM or DINO, or optimised models with quantization or TensorRT, and these are exactly the skills I want to build with you.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Tübingen and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
